label: Drag
description: Drag on the computer's screen: `args` is `{ path, button, modifiers }`. `path` is at least two points `{ x, y }` in screen pixels: the button goes down at the first, the mouse moves through the others, and the button comes up at the last. `button` is left (the default), right, middle, back or forward; `modifiers` are keys held throughout, joined by + (`shift`).

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: The drag, in the shape the node's description gives. RouteComputerCall's `drag` port hands it over from a model's tool call; written by hand, it is a record literal.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: What happened, in a sentence a model can read back as the tool's result.

metadataPorts.name: tools
metadataPorts.description: The tools a model calls this node through, in Anthropic's names and in OpenAI's: gather them up to the LLM node's `tools` through metadata ports.

anthropic.description: Press the left button at start_coordinate, move to coordinate, and release.
anthropic.name: left_click_drag

coordinate.description: Where it ends as [x, y], pixels from the left and top edges of the last full screenshot.

start_coordinate.description: Where the drag starts as [x, y], pixels from the left and top edges of the last full screenshot.

text.description: Keys to hold down during the action, joined by + (shift, ctrl+shift).

openai.description: Press the left button at the first point of path, move through the others, and release at the last.
openai.name: drag

keys.description: Keys to hold down during the action, like ["SHIFT"] or ["CTRL", "SHIFT"].

x.description: Across, pixels from the left and top edges of the last full screenshot.

y.description: Down, pixels from the left and top edges of the last full screenshot.
